headline.case: lower (talks in lowercase phrases, not shouty caps)
headline.size_rel: large, ~1 short phrase (1-4 words) per screen, centered mid-lower third

caption.family_guess: same as headline, single word/short-phrase burn-in
caption.size_rel: large, fills ~60-80% of frame width per word

layout.host_pos: seated, full-frame vertical, centered, chest-up, hands gesturing, plain gray studio wall behind
layout.safe_zones: caption band sits lower-middle third (~55-70% height); small circular avatar+chart insert appears top-center when a chart is referenced; top strip mostly clear
layout.caption_pos: one word/phrase burned in per ~1s beat, centered horizontally, vertically ~55-65% down frame, directly under/near speaker's chin

motion.cut_rate_per_10s: 0 hard cuts (single continuous talking-head take) but caption word changes every ~1s giving perceived pacing; occasional full-frame B-roll insert (charts, hardware photos, screenshots) replacing the host shot for 1-3s
transitions: hard swap between host frame and full-bleed B-roll/screenshot (no crossfade)
small circular PIP chart/graph appears floating top-center over host for data beats
